facts.value: The European Union will award scholarships to around 30 outstanding students in the first TELME cohort.
These scholarships cover tuition fees, travel expenses, and living costs.
Applications for the September 2026 intake open on 20th October 2025.
Are you passionate about language teaching, multilingual course design, or programme coordination?
TELME offers students high-quality multilingual training in the field of language education.
Université Rennes 2 (France), Åbo Akademi University (Finland), Adam Mickiewicz University (Poland), Universidad de Burgos (Spain), University of Limerick (Ireland).

TELME graduates will be well prepared for international careers in language teaching, curriculum and programme development, educational technology, intercultural communication, and other language-related careers.
The programme combines strong theoretical foundations with practical experience.
Students have the unique chance to study in several countries and explore diverse educational systems.
Students will join a vibrant international community of peers.
